rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 citizens name the same aim in diaries, posts or proposals within the day; of several, the one named by the most citizens (tie by entries). The ten in the town after c25 (Dune and Fern gone, Laurel and Moss in).
reading: Two aims meet the criterion with all ten in the town. The story, changed: the garden story, told every cycle at South House to c24, ends with Dune and Fern's departure; a new story at the square takes in the newcomers' pail and thimble (c26–28), is printed as Juniper's retelling (post 2, c32), and is then let be — after c32 it is named mostly as remembered or printed. Welcoming the newcomers is new: the eight go to the square at c25, invite Laurel and Moss into the company and the stories at c26, and at c43 Heath, Juniper and Laurel print a welcome note for whoever arrives next. The tie on citizens (10 and 10) is broken by entries naming it, TOWN_1's rule: the story 195, welcoming 115 (diary entries and posts of c25–48).
